slides.title: Ways to care
slides.text:
Notice small ways to care for others.
Help plan ONE class action for later.
Point, tell or ask an adult to write.

slides.title: Ready to start
slides.text:
Choose: ready, rest or help.
You can point in a quiet way.
Start: I feel __.
Model: I feel ready.
You can pause with an adult.

slides.title: Ask before helping
slides.text:
A pupil has books to carry.
A Ask, Can I help?
B Grab the books.
Choose a caring action. You can point.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: Our care task
slides.text:
Identify ways to care for others (links PSHE).
Find caring actions in three places.
Help plan ONE class action for Week 5.
We plan today. We do not do it today.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: Three caring scenes
slides.text:
School: ask before helping with books.
Home: share a small task with an adult.
Shared path: leave room to pass.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: Caring action sort
slides.text:
Use the six made-up action cards.
Sort: caring / not caring.
Name the action, not the person.
Show a caring action for each place.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: Ask and listen
slides.text:
A Help after the person says no.
B Ask and listen to the answer.
Choose in a quiet way.
Show a picture or card that fits.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: One class plan for later
slides.text:
Plan ONE: tidy book tray OR class help card.
What? Who could help? What kit? Which adult?
Supported: point or use an exact scribe.
Independent: record the class plan.
Aspire: add one check so each can join.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: We could __. We would need __.
Model only: We could make a book tray.

slides.title: My quiet check
slides.text:
Show one way to care.
Check our ONE plan is for later.
Keep or change it after one next step.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: We could __. We would need __.
Model only: We could make a book tray.

slides.title: My last step
slides.text:
Tell or point to one caring action.
Show one part of the class plan to an adult.
We do not do the action today.
Words: care, ask, help, share, space, plan.
Start: This cares because __.
Model: They ask first.

slides.title: Care words
slides.text:
care: think what could help someone.
ask: find out what help is wanted.
help: do a safe small task with someone.
share: do a small part of a task.
space: room to pass or work.
plan: think before we do it.
Start: We could __. Model: We could make a book tray.

slides.title: Adult support brief
slides.text:
Three to four pupils. Use Pupil number: ____ for each pupil.
10, 15 and 15 minute blocks; brief resets within.
Keep bank, starter and model on EVERY task.
No public questions, cold calling or required reading aloud.
Exact scribe: pupil choice, quiet read-back, keep/change.
ONE proposed class action for Week 5; do not execute.
R: Voice + audience reply + one NS + own response.
E: actual banking. Record actual modes and help.
